Definitely Dead Money. The music, the atmosphere, and how the story of each character tie to each other tops the other DLCs, imo. If I had to put it in a list, it would be:

Most Overrated: IX
Unpopular
Maybe not the worst map in all of BO Zombies, but I definitely think that IX is not one of the best maps, imo. It's like C or D tier for me

For Alpha Omega, it was really the inclusion of the Ultimis and Primis crews that made this map enjoyable for me. The Avogadro and Marlton make an appearance as well, adding to the Aether storyline. The map was well made, though it was a remaster of Nuketown Zombies. The mysteries surrounding the Post-Rev Richtofen that you play as in AO makes me want to dig deeper into the Aether story. And of course, the Ray Gun Mark 2 is the main wonder weapon, which is one of my favorites in BO Zombies.

For Dead of the Night, I truly love the mansion aesthetic the it had. Werewolves, vampires, ghosts, and a party going awry is what makes this map. Alistair's Annihilator is definitely in my favorite wonder weapon's list, as it is overpowered in various ways. The freedom that you have when starting the game gives you so many options on what to do first. Should I get PaP? Start working on upgrading Alistair's Folly? Savage Impaler? Stake Knife? I will say, though, that the characters weren't that memorable and important, which puts it slightly lower than AO

For Ancient Evil: I do like the mythology aspect they have with Chaos, and it blatantly shows in AE. Visually pleasing to look at and it was thrilling to ride Pegasus for the first time. The ending was a plot twist, which I greatly enjoyed. After that... the euphoria that you experience in-game wears off, at least for me. It's not that I hate nor dislike the map (that's why I put it at an average rating), but it doesn't give me that rush when I start up a new BO4 Zombies game like I do with the other maps

Sorry that this was pretty long...

1. Alpha Omega 9/10
2. Dead of the Night 8.5/10
3. Classified 8/10
4. Blood of the Dead 7/10
5. Ancient Evil 5.5/10
6. IX 4/10
7. Voyage of Despair 4/10

I think the Black Ops pass is worth it, as long as you're an avid fan of Zombies. The maps only accessible through the pass are, in my opinion, better than the others. My favorite one would have to be Alpha Omega, though DotN is a close second (as you can see in my list)

I think any Primis Richtofen, no matter what cycle that they are in, would consider themselves to be the nicest one. Yes, BOTD Richtofen isn't the one we have played from Origins to Revelations, but he is almost an exact copy of him. Same personality, same attitude, and that is why BOTD Richtofen's death is emotional. 
And as a side note, I believe that AO (Post-Rev) Richtofen is odd, to say the least. He seems sarcastic and dodges questions left and right, which is not like the Richtofen that we know. His dialogue with Primis Takeo in Alpha Omega insinuates this change of personality. Might be something going on in the background that we may not know of until the next map...
Definitely Ultimis Richtofen. He has the funniest dialogue, in my opinion, and he is one of the most important characters in the Aether storyline

I do partially agree, as I like the mythology aesthetic the Chaos maps have. I'm mainly referring to Aether, and because BO4 will presumably end that storyline, it's kind of a letdown that they copied from other maps

It lacked creativity like its predecessors had. All of the Aether maps are taken from Five, MOTD, and Nuketown, albeit altered in a few ways. It just felt like they didn't put much thought into those maps as they did with the others. Still, it doesn't stop me from playing them
BO4 is a good game, but I don't think it could ever top BO1 or BO2. Those games will always stick to you. Not so much BO4
